## Checklist

- [ ] I ran the test files related to my change (`node --test tests/unit/<related>.test.mjs`); CI runs the full suite.
- [ ] English and Traditional Chinese docs are in sync (for example `USAGE.md` and `USAGE.zh-TW.md`).
- [ ] If I changed plugin code (`.claude-plugin`, `.codex-plugin`, `.agents/plugins`, `codex-skills`, `skills`, `agents`, `hooks`, `scripts`, `workflows`), I bumped `version` in both plugin.json files to match and added a CHANGELOG entry (`CHANGELOG.md` and `CHANGELOG.zh-TW.md`).
- [ ] No secrets or private data in the diff.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).
